meta.pageDescription: Matt Murdock's portfolio. Lawyer by day, builder by night. Experience at Acme Inc., Evil Corp, and more.

hero.name: Matt Murdock
hero.subtagline: Bridging justice, technology, and teams that fight for what's right.

paragraphs: With over a decade between courtrooms, startups, and late-night code reviews, I work where ethics, product sense, and execution meet. My path started with civil litigation support at Acme Inc., then took a sharp turn through risk and compliance at Evil Corp, where I saw firsthand how systems fail people — and how to fix them.
I completed advanced studies in digital strategy, focusing on how organizations ship responsible products. I'm motivated by outcomes for real people, not slides or buzzwords.

roleParagraph.after: , I represent clients pro bono when it matters, and I build the tools that make our small firm punch above its weight. I believe the best services meet people where they are — and the best teams never stop learning how to do better.

timeline.title: Juris Doctor
timeline.description: Foundation in law, evidence, and trial practice — plus a lot of reading in the dark.

timeline.title: Legal Data Analyst
timeline.description: First professional chapter. Organized case discovery, built internal trackers, and learned how enterprises actually work.

timeline.title: Pro Bono & Appellate Clinic
timeline.description: Evening work representing neighbors who could not afford representation. The work that made the long hours feel honest.

timeline.title: Corporate Counsel (Contracts)
timeline.description: High-profile employer with questionable ethics. Negotiated vendor and data agreements, pushed back on overreach, and left when the mission no longer matched the values.

timeline.title: Attorney & Co-founder
timeline.description: Built a client-first practice with friends. By day, trials and strategy; by night, shipping the internal tools that keep cases organized.

paragraphs: I prepare like the unexpected will happen — because it will. I use plain language, tight timelines, and checklists that survive bad Wi‑Fi and worse surprises.
I collaborate like the outcome depends on the whole team — because it does. That means clear briefs, honest tradeoffs, and no mystique about what we're shipping next.
howIWork.quote: The best brief is the one that makes the next step obvious.
closingParagraphs: I do not just practice this myself — I expect it from co-counsel, vendors, and clients. We win when everyone knows what 'done' means.
Law and software both reward people who can adapt without losing the plot.

contact.blurb: Whether you have a case, a product idea, or you just need someone who has seen messy systems from the inside — I'd like to hear from you.
